purpose: Legacy single-App blueprint retained only as a migration marker. Production ANPOS commercial deployments must separate the customer-facing Marketplace GitHub App, the public/installable Repository Supervisor GitHub App, and the private Vendor Distribution GitHub App.
reason: Marketplace billing/Community audit, paid Repository Supervisor customer-repository writes, and vendor private-template distribution are distinct trust boundaries and must not share one GitHub App registration.
migration_rule: Do not configure GITHUB_APP_ID or GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY for new production deployments. Configure distinct GITHUB_MARKETPLACE_APP_*, GITHUB_SUPERVISOR_APP_*/client credentials, and GITHUB_VENDOR_APP_* credentials and verify role-separation/readiness checks.
security_requirements: Marketplace, Repository Supervisor, and Vendor App identities must be distinct.
Marketplace/Vendor private keys and Supervisor OAuth client credentials must not be reused across trust boundaries.
Marketplace App permissions must never be widened to implement Repository Supervisor writes.
Vendor template Administration permission must never be granted to the customer-facing Marketplace or Repository Supervisor App merely for vendor-side collaborator provisioning.
This deprecated file is not an App registration and contains no credentials.
